headline: This law extends for fiscal year 2021 a rule that let counties receive certain Secure Rural Schools payments without having to make a separate election.
what_it_does: The Secure Rural Schools and Community Self-Determination Act of 2000 pays counties for federal land within their borders, because that land cannot be taxed. Normally, counties must elect to receive certain payments under that act. This law keeps that election requirement from applying for fiscal year 2021.

who_it_affects.group: Counties that contain untaxable federal land
who_it_affects.how: They can receive certain Secure Rural Schools payments for fiscal year 2021 without having to make the election the act would otherwise require.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 15, 2022, and applies to fiscal year 2021.
